framework_variants.name: version/help/parser
framework_variants.behavior: --version/-v standalone returns informational version exit0. Normal System.CommandLine help/parser; no explicit command aliases in source; option aliases are separate spelling metadata.

framework_variants.name: global options/profile precedence
framework_variants.behavior: Recursive --url/-u, --token/-t, --format/-f, --output/-o, --profile/-p. URL/token/format resolve CLI>EVENTSTORE_ADMIN_*>explicit/active profiles>http://localhost:5002/no token/table. Store ~/.eventstore/profiles.json, never McpCli mcpcli.json; no store read performed during investigation.

framework_variants.name: output/exit/privacy
framework_variants.behavior: Remote commands table default/json/csv, errors/progress generally stderr; stdout or UTF8 file output (overwrite), empty collections may emit no stdout; exit0 success,1 degraded,2 error. Config commands often write directly to console rather than OutputWriter. JSON profiles/current expose tokens; report this gap, do not perpetuate as target behavior.

framework_variants.name: HTTP client
framework_variants.behavior: Bearer HTTP Admin API client, timeout10s, structured safe problem-detail mapping; TryGet returns null on404, writes accept200/202; health wait explicitly polls and tolerates transient AdminApiExceptions. Not a gateway envelope client.

framework_variants.name: server authority and current unsafe confirmation gap
framework_variants.behavior: All matching Admin controllers require EventStoreHuman plus endpoint role policy; tenant list specifically AdminFull, other scoped reads AdminReadOnly, projection/snapshot writes AdminOperator. These human surfaces cannot be treated as available agent-client contracts. Registered projection and snapshot mutations have no local --confirm/--yes prompt; do not invent confirmation protection or approve agent execution.
